description: Original Tardigrade Mossdrop animated companion by Cozy Critters Studio, designed with a pale moss-green segmented body, four pairs of short lobopod legs and cream claw tips. Original nine-state choreography includes phase-offset crawling, a tun-inspired curl, dewdrop handling and a deliberately cartoon hop. This is an original exploration, not an established franchise or a popularity claim.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
